# Luis Howin Maina

> UX researcher, UI designer, and web developer based in Nairobi, Kenya. Building human-centered digital products with AI at Beben Design.

## About

Luis Howin Maina is a Nairobi-based UX researcher, UI designer, and front-end web developer. He designs and builds digital products that prioritize clarity, usability, and simplicity. His work spans UX research, mobile UI (iOS & Android), HMI design for hardware products, design systems, prototyping, and front-end development.

He is the founder of Beben Design, a design studio focused on careful thinking and disciplined craft. He builds with AI as a creative partner — handling the design decisions, taste, and empathy while leveraging AI for technical execution.

## Location

Nairobi, Kenya (1°17′S 36°49′E)

## Capabilities

- UX Research: User interviews, usability testing, behavioral analysis
- Mobile UI: iOS & Android native interface design
- HMI Design: Physical-digital interfaces for hardware products
- Design Systems: Component libraries, design tokens, scalable frameworks
- Prototyping: Interactive prototypes for validation before code
- Front-End Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive builds

## Selected Projects

- **Moto Digital Dash**: Glanceable motorcycle dashboard UI for ESP32 hardware. Safety-critical, high-vibration HMI design.
- **Trek Watch 91**: Wearable UI for hikers prioritizing legibility and essential outdoor data.
- **Sprite**: AI-powered site navigation guide for beben.design. Conversational UI that helps visitors find information contextually.
